message: PctChrome (libs/components/widget/src/chrome.ts) writes a `host` block this read does not take as written
$reason: The role and the name spread into the host block from a condition, which ngc evaluates into the host's attributes (measured through ngc in partial mode by the review of this change). The read takes a spread of an object written in place or of a `const` of the file's own (`hostOf`); any other spread is a block it does not take as written, and point 1 refuses it. Passed over, it let the named presentational host through every point.
